title: Why are they blow-drying a ski jump?! 💨
description:
Re-live the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch

This isn't just satisfying to watch—it's critical safety work.
Ski jump crews use industrial leaf blowers to remove moisture and ice from the in-run. At speeds reaching 90km/h, even small amounts of water can affect an athlete's run or cause dangerous conditions.

This is the precision and dedication that happens before you ever see an athlete compete. The Olympics are built on thousands of people doing essential work behind the scenes.
The detail that goes into Olympic sports is mind-blowing.
